selected_result: Lemma 2.3, second exact forward-error expansion for a general binary summation tree

bibliographic_source.title: Deterministic and Probabilistic Error Bounds for Floating Point Summation Algorithms

paper_locations.anchor: Equation (2.1), definition of f_k, Lemma 2.3 equations (2.5) and (2.6)

task_clarification: For any finite binary summation tree and signed real leaves, use a relative-error witness for each actual rounded internal addition. Let s_k be the exact partial sum at each node, e_k its computed-minus-exact error, and f_k the sum of its two child errors.

Formalize both exact Lemma 2.3 identities: e_k equals the sum over all internal descendants including k of (s_j+f_j)*delta_j, and f_k equals the same sum restricted to strict descendants of k. A recursively flattened list of those node-local terms is equivalent to the paper's node-order notation.
Preserve arbitrary tree shape and the one-leaf zero-error case. This is an exact deterministic identity, not a probabilistic or first-order statement.
scope_constraints: The model must link each delta_j to the rounded addition of computed child operands and bound it by the unit roundoff.
Do not assume either target identity, omit internal nodes, or specialize to sequential summation.
Do not replace the source's (s_j+f_j) delta_j term with the Lemma 2.2 strict-ancestor product expression.
